Not Long Ago

How It Used To Work

You opened Photoshop or Canva and you built it by hand.

Every layer. Every font choice. One graphic could take an hour.

LOGO
Then This Happened

Type It.
Get It.

Describe the graphic in a sentence — get it back in seconds.

That hour became a minute. So everybody started doing it… and something went wrong.

Spot The Difference

Which One Is Ours?

LOGO
The Tells

Why You Can Tell

Too Many WordsIt fills every inch — a headline, a subtitle, three slogans and a date. Nobody reads all that.
Same LookPurple-blue gradient, everything centered, a rocket emoji — you've seen this exact graphic a hundred times
No BrandNothing on it says this school — swap the words and it's any school in America

The tool is trained to please everybody. Which means it looks like everything.

LOGO
The Fix

Give It Your Brand

Set It OnceOur navy, our gold, our fonts, the eagle — saved in one place the AI reads every single time
It HoldsNow everything it makes comes back in our colors, not the internet's — the fiftieth graphic matches the first
All WeekThis screen. Every slide since Monday. Same navy, same gold, same fonts — built with AI that was handed our brand and held onto it

The tool brings the speed. You bring the brand.

Where's The Line?

Bigger Than Pictures

PlanningA month of posts mapped out before you make one — strategy, not scrambling
OrganizingShot lists, schedules, file naming, who-does-what — the boring half that makes teams work
AutomatingThe same job, done the same way, every week — set it up once and stop doing it by hand
BuildingReal apps — this screen was built with AI. I'll walk you through it.
